name: STP&I Public Company Limited
summary: STP&I Public Company Limited engages in the fabrication of steel works, and manufacture and sale of boilers and pressure vessels in Thailand, Australia, the United States, Canada. It offers steel structures for airports, exhibition halls, and high-rise buildings; industrial plants, such as factories, automobile plants, and steel mills; power plants, such as boiler structures, turbine buildings, and equipment support structures; petrochemical plants comprising refineries, and gas separation and aromatic plants; and bridges consisting of built-in cable anchor structural decks, main structures, decking for cable stay bridges, flyovers, and pipe bridges jetties.
